title: Downtime, explained honestly by treatment type
summary: What "downtime" really means across injectables, devices and lasers.
body:
Downtime varies enormously between treatment categories, from none at all to a week of visible redness, and patients are often surprised by how different it can be.

Knowing what to expect in advance is part of giving informed consent, which is why we set expectations clearly at consultation rather than after treatment.

As a general guide, injectables carry the least visible downtime, device-led treatments sit in the middle, and ablative laser treatments carry the most, though individual healing time still varies between patients.
